Plugin.Name: Unraid Secretary Office
Plugin.Overview:
Backup and restore for your whole Unraid server — snapshots, database dumps, every app and VM with its configuration, encrypted offsite backup to S3, a NAS or a second Unraid server. Plus a media cache for Emby (Plex and Jellyfin coming), a smarter mover and a security watch.
Backup: nightly ZFS/btrfs snapshots, database dumps, one package per app and VM including XML, UEFI/TPM and templates. Optional encrypted offsite backup to S3 storage or a NAS (built on Kopia), or two Unraid servers keep each other's backups — only the changes travel.
Restore: databases, folders, whole shares, templates and VMs. What gets replaced is set aside, never deleted, and restore drills on throwaway copies prove the backups really come back.
Snapshots: ZFS, btrfs and VM snapshots with schedules and simple retention.
Media cache & mover: what people are watching in Emby is fetched onto the fast pool, so the array disks can sleep. The oldest files move to the array only when the pool is above your limit, and a live picture shows the night run.
Security & tidying: how securely the server stands, a watch book of anything unusual (UniFi routers too), every log in one place, and unused data cleared into a storeroom instead of deleted.
Free and open source (GPL-3.0), no account, no cloud, nothing locked. English, German, Italian, French, Spanish.
Plugin.Requires: Unraid 7.3.2 or a newer 7.x (Unraid 8 is not supported yet). The nightly backup's snapshots need pools or array disks on ZFS or btrfs (shares on XFS are backed up without a snapshot); partner offices need ZFS. Offsite copies need a Kopia container — the Consultant can install it.
Plugin.DonateText: Tips keep the office going — a share goes to helmi1987, who wrote the tools behind Jack Streamer and Ms. Moverelli, and what goes beyond our costs to animal shelters.
